scope: W-54 competitor and workload coverage gaps; open items block the complete performance goal

gaps.description: No inventory item has a locked release, build recipe, or verified executable; every cell stays pending until a lock and a correctness run exist.

Discovery has covered planning seeds and upstream repositories found so far. Package registries, academic literature, archived project lists, and commercial runtimes have not been searched systematically.
Deployment stacks (FrankenPHP, RoadRunner, Swoole family) need web workloads; they must not be compared with execution cores on CLI cells as if equivalent.

Only six engine-level CLI workloads are frozen. Real-application workloads (WordPress/WooCommerce, Laravel, BookStack and others owned by W-56 to W-58), HTTP concurrency sweeps, overload, and recovery workloads are not yet defined as matrix cells.
Holdout workloads that are withheld until measurement have not been prepared.
Expected outputs come from PHP 8.5.12 on emulated linux/386 only. A native 64-bit reference run is still required to confirm platform-independent output.
Resource budgets, security mode, build flags, repetition count, sample-size and stop rules from chapter 37 are not yet recorded per cell.
